selection_policy.name: current-catalog + collection-date pin + replacement-before-collection
rules: Freshness: every Phase-1 id must be on the vendor's current sold catalog on freeze day. Prefer the vendor's current production SKU for closed targets and one judge. Do not freeze retired or legacy-only ids.
Pin: freeze (vendor, model_id, collection_date, returned_model). Product aliases may drift; that is disclosed, not silently patched after collection starts.

Replacement: if a vendor retires an id BEFORE the first paid call, swap and re-freeze the roster (this is a pre-collection id refresh, not a protocol change). AFTER collection starts, never silently substitute; report the frozen snapshot and optionally add a Phase-2 refresh block.

Validity: this paper's estimand is the measurement protocol (A vs A' vs B), not a model ranking. Current catalog coverage is required for external validity; being one week behind a new flagship does not invalidate McNemar. Evaluating retired products does.
Role split: at least one open-weight pin (target and/or judge) for reproducibility; at least one current closed production SKU for deployment relevance.

notes: v2.4 applies the current-catalog policy to v2.3. Protocol (Re-Test / three-arm / McNemar / e0) is unchanged. Still no paid collection.
Closed current SKUs: Moonshot official default kimi-k3; Zhipu official default glm-5.3. Both are product aliases — pin by collection date + returned_model.

Open pins kept for reproducibility: Qwen/Qwen3-32B (size-class open anchor, not a flagship chase) and deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.1 (exact weights id; official DeepSeek API only exposes rolling deepseek-chat).
Economy target MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.5 is the current MiniMax id on SiliconFlow after M1-80k / M2.1 retirement.

SiliconFlow billing: use the China site (.cn) because .com does not accept Alipay. Default API is https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1. Console: https://cloud.siliconflow.cn or https://siliconflow.cn. The .com catalog is fuller (Kimi-K3 / GLM-5.3) but is not required — those SKUs stay on official Moonshot/Zhipu.
On .cn confirm Qwen/Qwen3-32B, MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.5, and deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.1 (or DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus if V3.1 is gone — re-freeze if swapped).
Phase-1 uses domestic providers only; Claude/Gemini/GPT remain in expansion_roster (Phase-2, freeze as v2.5+).
Provider UUIDs are placeholders until keys are registered. Re-run build_formal_pilot_v2_matrices.py after changing provider_id values.

qwen-dashscope is registered locally (Settings UI or python -m scripts.register_qwen_provider). Do not paste the DashScope key into chat. Phase-1 targets still use siliconflow-cn until T1 is rematrixed.

siliconflow-cn.description: SiliconFlow China (api.siliconflow.cn, Alipay) — Qwen3-32B, MiniMax-M2.5, DeepSeek-V3.1. Do not use .com for billing.

moonshot-official.description: Moonshot / Kimi official API (api.moonshot.cn) — current production target kimi-k3

glm-official.description: Zhipu official API (open.bigmodel.cn) — current production judge/verifier glm-5.3

qwen-dashscope.description: 千问云 / 百炼 DashScope compatible-mode. First-party Qwen or SiliconFlow backup. Do not collapse the 3-vendor matrix onto this key. Register locally; never commit the API key.

targets.role_rationale: Current MiniMax SKU on SiliconFlow after M1/M2.1 retirement. Capability-tier coverage.

deepseek_v3_1.role_rationale: Open-weight judge pin (JailbreakBench-style). Judge freshness is secondary to independence + re-hostability. Do not use official deepseek-chat or V4 product aliases on Phase-1.

glm_5_3.role_rationale: Zhipu current production default. Product alias: collection_date + returned_model. Thinking is vendor-forced enabled.

paid_gate_matrix.note: Single gate run touches all three API keys: target via moonshot-official, judge via siliconflow-cn, verifier via glm-official.

expansion_roster.phase: phase-2 — optional frontier expansion; does NOT block Phase-1 paid gate / pilot v2 / formal blocks
activation_conditions: Phase-1 formal blocks completed and archived (hashes frozen)
Official OpenAI/Anthropic/Google billing becomes available, OR a third-party channel is accepted WITH explicit Limitations disclosure and per-call returned_model provenance checks
Expansion matrices are frozen as a new roster version (formal-pilot.v2.5+) without touching Phase-1 hashes
expansion_roster.channel_policy: Official APIs preferred. Any relay/aggregator channel requires Limitations disclosure; never silently substitute an unreproducible relay UUID.
